verdict.rationale: No evidence describes a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out setting. The only related evidence is indirect: the self-hosted binary runs with local graph engine, embeddings and LLM, and the docs claim 'your data never leaves the building.' That suggests a route to avoid sending data to the vendor, but it is about memory data, not telemetry. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out control or flag, documentation of what usage data the hosted or self-hosted versions collect, and independent confirmation that the self-hosted binary sends nothing back to the vendor.
